 # Building .deb files
 Take your source tarball, rename it to qview-c_#.#.orig.tar.gz and extract it to qview-c-#.#. Move the debian folder to the qview-c-#.# folder. Make sure to change the versions in control and changelog, the date on the changelog, and the maintainer name if it is not you.

 I just build the source deb and use the launchpad ppa binaries
